answer: Each identity locks a 70-credit bond in kernel escrow and names its inviter on a public referral graph. Any peer can dispute an identity by replaying its grove edges: a star cluster or reused seal burns both bonds; the disputer takes 25. A ferrous stamp seals each edge, tying a borrowed stamp to its lender. The k-th fake pays 48+5(k-1): 1,000 fakes cost 2,545,500 plus 70,000 locked vs a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 48 once, keeping its bond.
